name: App Icon: Duotone Straw-Hat Master Profile
purpose: Primary App Store Icon — Cinematic Master Profile.
description: Side profile solid black silhouette of a wandering master samurai wearing a conical straw hat with katana over shoulder, inside a single solid flat bright red circular disc.
prompt: Masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector logo icon. (Dramatic side-view solid pitch-black silhouette of a master ronin samurai with conical straw kasa hat carrying a katana over shoulder:1.3). (Directly centered inside a single solid flat bright red circular sun disc:1.4). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). Duotone color palette of pure black and vibrant bright red only (#FF2035). Flat 2D vector stencil logo design, razor-sharp clean geometric edges, no white color, no human face, no skin, no 3D rendering, no soft lighting, no shading, no gradients, no textures, no noise, no rays, no text, no watermark.
